**DonorDock and Virtuous are both donor CRMs for nonprofits, with DonorDock being simpler, more affordable, and easier to use for small organizations, while Virtuous offers advanced personalization and data insights for larger or more sophisticated teams.**[1][2][5][6]

### Key Comparison
| Category          | DonorDock                                                                 | Virtuous                                                                 |
|-------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Pricing**      | $98/month base + card fees; no setup fee, unlimited contacts, no contracts.[1][2] | Monthly fees + 2.9% + $0.30 transaction fees; setup fee required.[1][2] |
| **Ease of Use**  | Easier to use, set up, and administer; preferred for business dealings.[6] | User-friendly interface but more complex for advanced features.[6][7]   |
| **Target Fit**   | Small nonprofits needing basic donor tracking, emails, and activity logging.[5] | Larger organizations ready for sophisticated donor journeys and automation.[5][7] |
| **Core Features**| Donor database, segmentation, email campaigns, automated receipts, volunteer tools, mobile access.[3][4] | Personalized donor automation, wealth/social data insights, email/marketing, campaign tools, integrations (e.g., Mailchimp, Stripe).[4][7] |
| **Support**      | Tiered by plan, business hours.[1]                                       | Tiered by plan, business hours; noted as accessible.[1][7]              |
| **User Ratings** | High for small/medium businesses (9.6/9.0); strong in communications, reporting.[2] | Matches DonorDock for small/medium (9.6/9.0); strong in personalization.[2] |
| **Company Info** | Founded 2017, US-based.[3]                                               | Founded 2014, US-based.[3]                                              |

DonorDock excels in affordability and simplicity for grassroots groups, while Virtuous provides deeper analytics and automation for scaling generosity, though at higher costs.[1][4][5][7] Both support donation tracking, events, pledges, and recurring gifts, but lack some tools like auctions found in alternatives.[1][3] Review sites like G2 and TrustRadius show comparable satisfaction, with DonorDock edging out on usability.[2][6] For 2026 needs, evaluate based on team size and budget.[3][5]
